messages:
ana: Heads-up — while previewing the perf guide on staging the throughput graph image 403s. staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/perf/benchmarks#graphs :frowning:
rob: ugh, which file/line? can you paste the snippet?
ana: file is `docs/perf/benchmarks.md`. image block around line 88 uses `https://cdn.internal.redwood.ai/assets/bench-2025.png` which returns 403 in the staging preview. snippet:
```html
![throughput graph](https://cdn.internal.redwood.ai/assets/bench-2025.png)
```
lin: saw that earlier today — scanner should have flagged it.
doc-scan-bot: Link scanner: detected 1 broken external asset in `docs/perf/benchmarks.md` -> https://cdn.internal.redwood.ai/assets/bench-2025.png. Flagged 2026-03-21T15:20:00Z.
rob: options: (1) rehost the PNG under docs (preferred), (2) replace with an inline SVG, or (3) remove image and add alt text + link to raw artifact. if it's a design asset we need design signoff.
ana: this one is generated by perf infra (not design). rehosting is fine and keeps the page self-contained.
lin: i can regenerate the PNG from the perf job artifacts and upload to `docs/assets/bench-2025.png` in the repo, then update the two files that reference it. i'll keep the new image optimized to avoid large diffs.
rob: run a quick grep before the PR: `rg "bench-2025.png" -n docs || true` to confirm other refs.
lin: ran it — two hits: `docs/perf/benchmarks.md:88` and `docs/quickstarts/perf-setup.md:12`. i'll update both in one PR.
nana: please keep the replacement caption minimal to reduce i18n churn; quickstarts are localized. ping #i18n after merge. also add a one-line changelog note in the PR description that this is docs-only.
lin: PR draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7490 "docs(perf): rehost bench graph and fix broken CDN link" — will assign to ana for staging verification. commit message: "docs(perf): add local bench-2025.png and replace external CDN link".
rob: add labels `docs-fix` and `needs-i18n`. after merge run `doc-scan-bot rescan docs/perf/benchmarks.md` to clear the scanner flag.
doc-scan-bot: Reminder queued: run `doc-scan-bot rescan docs/perf/benchmarks.md` after PR merge to clear the flagged item.
nana: thanks — i'll smoke-test staging once you merge. lin: ping here when ready and i'll verify the image loads and the caption still reads correctly. :thumbsup:
